projects.title: SPaT / R2X-assisted crosswalk navigation
projects.description: Integrated ROS 2, Nav2 and a hybrid safety node to make crossing decisions from signal phase and remaining green time. Compared SPaT and vision-based navigation under daytime, nighttime and dynamic occlusion conditions.

projects.title: VLM-based intersection context understanding
projects.description: Investigating infrastructure-camera scene understanding for AMR waiting, entry and crossing decisions. The thesis plan covers pedestrians, vehicles, crosswalk occupancy and occlusion, with simulation and scenario-based evaluation.

projects.title: LiDAR navigation & cloud robot experiments
projects.description: Worked on LiDAR mapping, localization and Nav2 integration for mobile robots, including FAST-LIO navigation experiments at KAIST Munji Campus.

projects.title: Delivery robot digital twin
projects.description: Configured an Isaac Sim delivery robot pipeline with LiDAR, IMU, camera, odometry, joint states and ROS 2 communication for navigation scenarios.

projects.title: LLM-guided planning in nuPlan
projects.description: Prototyped an LLM context interpreter that adjusts rule-based PDM planner parameters. Implemented an uncooperative overtaking scenario in nuPlan and compared behavior with a mode-selection baseline.

projects.title: Multi-camera pedestrian trajectory perception
projects.description: Combined YOLOv8, DeepSORT, Re-ID and homography across five CCTV views to study consistent global IDs and pedestrian trajectory recovery.

projects.title: V2X / C-ITS intersection field experiments
projects.description: Contributed to scenario design, GNSS trajectory collection and analysis of driving behavior around intersection blind spots.

projects.title: Infrastructure-based pedestrian recognition
projects.description: Compared object detection models for real-time pedestrian recognition in infrastructure-based path prediction systems.

projects.title: Face recognition for automatic door control
projects.description: Developed motion detection with Gaussian Mixture Models, evaluated face detectors and integrated RetinaFace with WebSocket-based face recognition for automatic access control.

projects.title: Driver attention & abnormal vehicle detection
projects.description: Developed vision-based driver gaze and hazardous-object detection components for warning systems. Work included gaze data acquisition and abnormal vehicle behavior analysis.
